rationale.intuition: Low GPA + High SAT 的不一致档案。UMich anchor 15.6%，OOS 通常 ~12%。GPA 3.4 远低于 admit 中位（UMich admit GPA 中位 ~3.9），强 SAT 帮助有限。Engine 应明显低于 anchor。

sources.name: UMich CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Admit pool GPA 25th percentile ~3.7; SAT middle 50 1360-1530; applicant SAT 1550 above 75th but GPA well below 25th

sources.name: NACAC State of College Admission 2024 §3.1
sources.evidence: GPA is consistently rated 'considerably important' by 75%+ of admissions officers; isolated high test score doesn't compensate for transcript pattern
